title: Mutual Action Plan: Helix Labs onboarding slate + GPU tranche sizing
text:
Mutual Action Plan: Helix Labs onboarding slate + GPU tranche sizing

['From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Sato <matthew@helixlabs.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Helix Labs onboarding slate + GPU tranche sizing

Matthew — good talking earlier. Per our call I put together a short onboarding slate and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) focused on capacity reservation for Dedicated/Private deployments. High level asks below and a proposed cadence to close: 

Summary (please skim)
- Goal: Support Helix production pilot (Gen-2 summarization + reranking) with predictable latency under 120ms p99 and < $0.02 per 1k tokens for steady-state.
- Minimum committed tranche: 8 H100-equivalent GPUs for Dedicated or 10 A100-80GB equiv for Private (node-level constraints differ).
- MAP milestones: Evaluation sprint (2 weeks), Staging run (3 weeks), Reserved commit & procurement trigger, Onboarding & acceptance (4 weeks).

Key dates (proposed)
- Eval kickoff: 2027-06-16
- Eval complete: 2027-06-30
- Procurement trigger / commit window: 2027-07-05 — this is the date we need purchase commitment to meet an Aug delivery window for Dedicated tranches.

Questions for you to confirm
1) Procurement lead & legal approver (procurement contact or PO cadence)?
2) Is air-gapped / on-prem install required or will VPC-private be sufficient?
3) Are you open to staggered tranches (4 + 4) to shorten lead time?

Attachments I will circulate in a follow-up: MAP PDF, sizing estimate, and term sheet.

Next step: If this looks reasonable please loop in your procurement contact and I’ll circulate the formal MAP and our proposed acceptance test prompts.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

', "From: Matthew Sato <matthew@helixlabs.ai>

Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 14:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Helix Labs onboarding slate + GPU tranche sizing

Jordan — thanks for the outline, that aligns directionally. Quick answers:
- Procurement contact will be procure@helixlabs.ai (I've cc'd a procurement inbox on this thread). Elena is our PM for the pilot and will own acceptance criteria with us.
- For now VPC-private should be sufficient; we may revisit on-prem if compliance gating shows up.
- Staggered tranches are interesting — I need clarification on the throughput hit for a split delivery. Can you call out expected sustained RPS for 8 vs 4+4?

A couple of constraints from our side:
- Finance needs a firm monthly run-rate estimate before we can sign off on a tranche commit.
- We have an internal compliance window mid-July where SOC2 evidence must be reviewed.

Happy to kick off the eval on 6/16 if you can send the MAP and the benchmark prompt set by COB Mon 6/14.

Matt
Head of ML Ops, Helix Labs
matthew@helixlabs.ai

", "From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Matthew Sato <matthew@helixlabs.ai>, Elena Martinez <elena@helixlabs.ai>, procure@helixlabs.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Mutual Action Plan: Helix Labs onboarding slate + GPU tranche sizing

Jordan / team — attached is a concise sizing estimate (summary below). I also flagged lead times for Dedicated capacity vs Private on-prem procurement.

Sizing summary (baseline model: 30B param decoder, 512 token avg, quantized fp16/8 where applicable)
- Option A (single tranche): 8x H100-equivalent GPUs dedicated -> Sustained throughput ~4200 reqs/hour (approx 28 RPS), p99 @512 tokens ~95ms. Monthly list-run rate estimate: $XX,XXX (I attached the spreadsheet with tiered pricing).
- Option B (staggered): 4x (immediate) + 4x (T+6 weeks) -> immediate throughput ~14 RPS, with full capacity reached after second tranche. Monthly blended run-rate depends on tranche timing; worst-case short-term cost-to-perf is ~12% higher during partial delivery.
- Option C (Private nodes): 10x A100-80GB-equivalent -> slightly lower latency at very high concurrency but longer lead time and higher one-time infra cost.

Lead time notes
- Dedicated (hosted reserved): If commit is signed by 2027-07-05 we can allocate a reserved pool and start onboarding in early-Aug. Typical activation: 3-5 weeks to full readiness once reserved capacity assigned.
- Private (VPC/managed): For VPC-private we can provision within 4-6 weeks post-commit but if Helix requires on-prem hardware procurement (customer-procured or APAC data center), lead times extend to 10-14 weeks depending on vendor shipments.

Acceptance criteria to include in MAP (recommended)
- Performance: p99 latency < 120ms at 512 tokens for 95th percentile of test prompts.
- Quality: end-to-end regression < 2% on your benchmark set (we'll snapshot eval).
- Operational: 99.9% availability during the 2-week staging run.

Attachments: gpu-sizing-estimate.xlsx (breakdown), MAP-Helix-2027-v1.pdf (template), redwood-sla-term-sheet.pdf

Happy to sync quickly and finalize numbers for finance.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

", "From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + benchmark set (Helix) 

Matt/Elena — attaching the formal MAP and our benchmark prompt set per the ask from your call. Highlights:

MAP high level (attached PDF)
- Week 0: Contracting & SOC2 checklist handoff (procurement & security evidence)
- Week 1–2: Eval sprint run by Helix + Redwood (we provide benchmark harness & trace hooks)
- Week 3–5: Staging run with realtime telemetry; acceptance gates executed by Helix PM
- Week 6: Commit decision and procurement trigger (if signed we start tranche activation)

Acceptance test artifacts included in the ZIP: prompt_set_v1.txt, perf_measure_spec.md

Per Ben's sizing sheet, I've summarized two purchase options in the MAP and called out the procurement trigger date of 2027-07-05 to hit an early-Aug activation for Dedicated pools. Please review and (a) confirm procurement PO cadence, (b) sign MAP v1 if you agree to the milestones, or (c) propose alternate commit date if your finance cycle needs it.

Attachments: MAP-Helix-2027-v1.pdf, gpu-sizing-estimate.xlsx

Best,
Jordan

", 'From: procure@helixlabs.ai <procure@helixlabs.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Matthew Sato <matthew@helixlabs.ai>, Elena Martinez <elena@helixlabs.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:38:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP + benchmark set (Helix)

Jordan / Ben — reviewed the MAP and the pricing worksheet. Procurement is prepared to move forward with a staggered tranche (4 + 4) subject to two items: 

1) DocuSign for the Master Services Agreement and the reservation addendum (we initiated an envelope: https://www.docusign.net/ENVELOPE/9876543210) — we will route for approval by 6/23/2027.
2) Final monthly run-rate for the first 4-unit tranche (we need the exact invoice schedule and cancellation terms).

We also note SOC2 artifacts must be handed to our security team by 07/12 to meet a compliance review on 07/20. Please confirm you can provide the SOC2 evidence link and a short onboarding checklist by 7/12.

If both items are satisfied we will route an initial PO for the first tranche on 06/27 and target a provisioning date of 2027-08-09 for the first 4 GPUs to enter the Dedicated pool. Second tranche commissioning targeted 6 weeks after the PO.

Regards,
Helix Labs Procurement Team
procure@helixlabs.ai
